title: Tirana protest outside the Interior Ministry with reported clashes between opposition supporters
location: Outside the Ministry of Interior, Tirana
scope: One reported local gathering; relationship to any later daily protest campaign remains unverified.
organizer: Not established; participants identified as supporters of Shqipëria Bëhet and Lëvizja Bashkë.
threshold_50_evidence: Unknown; the opened report provides no attendance estimate. A search-only Gazeta Jon lead cannot establish attendance.

start_date.summary: A2 CNN article dated 20 January 2025 says the protest took place that evening.

location.summary: A2 CNN places it outside the Interior Ministry in Tirana.

organizer.summary: The report identifies supporters of two movements but does not identify an organizer.

protester_violence.summary: A2 CNN reports physical clashes between supporters of the two movements; it does not attribute violence to state actors.

state_response.summary: The article does not establish a response by the state to the gathering.

notes: This is a lead for review, not a verified eligible mobilization: the opened contemporary report establishes a protest, date and location, but no demand directed at the Albanian state or attendance threshold. Search-only Gazeta Jon material alleges a justice demand and large turnout, but remains unverified because its access scan deferred. Do not infer its claims into coded fields.
open_questions: What state-directed demand, if any, defined the gathering?
Was the gathering organized by one of the movements, both, or another group?
Did daily protests continue after 20 January, and are they one episode or distinct actions?
What was the state response and actual end time?
